title: Prisons N -W F P Amendment Act 1996

sections.shortTitle: Prisons N -W F P Amendment Act 1996
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

PRISONS (NORTH-WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1996
PRISONS (NORTH-WEST FRONTIER
PROVINCE) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1996
ACT III OF 1996
An Act further to amend the Prisons
Act, 1894
[Gazette of N.-W.F.P.
Extraordinary, 28th July, 1996]
No. PA/N.-W.F.P./Legis/96/12549,
dated 28-7-1996.---The Prisons ( North-West Frontier Province) (Amendment)
Bill, 1996, having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of the North-West
Frontier Province on the 24th June, 1996 and assented to by the
Governor of the North-West Frontier Province on the 15th July, 1996, is hereby
published as an act of the Provincial Legislature of North-West Frontier
Province,
1. Short title and
commencement.----(1) This Act may be called the Prisons (North-West
Frontier Province Amendment) Act, 1996.

2. Amendment of section 46 of
Act IX of 1894. In the Prisons Act, 1894 (IX of 1894), hereinafter referred to as the said Act, in section 46,---
(a)    clause
(7) shall be deleted;
(b)   the
semi-colon appearing at the end of clause (11) shall be replaced by a colon;
and
(c)    clause
(12) shall be deleted.
